cs.t: I don't recommend the HE-400, but the HE-400i instead. The HE-400 has the old Hifiman headband, the old pads, and the old cable, and suffers from a boomy bass issue. Replacing the pads and cables (absolutely required, new pads fix boomy bass issue some but not all, old cable breaks easily) raise the cost to be almost as much as the HE-400i, and you can't ever fix the headband issue. The HD650/HD650 and AKG K701/Q701/Kxx/K712 family however I do agree with. Also, the DT770 isn't fully closed, its semi-open. The DT990 also isn't fully open, its semi-open. They are merely closer to each end of the spectrum, with DT880 in the middle of semi-open, but they're ALL semi-open. Disclosure: Former DT880/600 Premium owner, current HE-400i owner.
